text: Thank you, Council Member Plummer. This country has a history of using federal highway expansions to remove primarily African American citizens from urban core areas for gentrification and other economic development purposes. This is part of America's racist history, from a time when African Americans didn't have political power. We should not allow this to happen in Houston, Texas, today. There are other options for highway expansion that do not require removing people from their homes. I am doing all I can to help you and spread the word about this issue. Thank you for your continued, educated, and informed political advocacy.
